name: Guide to Developing a National Cybersecurity Strategy (1st Edition, 2018)
description: First edition (2018) — Guide to Developing a National Cybersecurity Strategy.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by International Telecommunication Union (itu.int) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for International Telecommunication Union (itu.int).
